'''Hangar 18''' was a storage hangar on the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Located in [[Level 1325/Legends|Level 1325]], it was here where [[Fives/Legends|CT-5555]] met with [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] due to a framed crime and [[Grand Plan/Legends|conspiracy]].
